strings: CREATE TABLE room_master_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,identity_hash TEXT)Y

CREATE TABLE `tile` (`uuid` TEXT NOT NULL, `floorId` TEXT NOT NULL, `minX` REAL NOT NULL, `minY` REAL NOT NULL, `maxX` REAL NOT NULL, `maxY` REAL NOT NULL, `tileFolder` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`uuid`, `floorId`), FOREIGN KEY(`floorId`) REFERENCES `floor`(`uuid`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )'

CREATE TABLE `marker` (`uuid` TEXT NOT NULL, `floorId` TEXT NOT NULL, `scanId` TEXT, `swlId` TEXT, `value` INTEGER NOT NULL, `x` REAL NOT NULL, `y` REAL NOT NULL, `endX` REAL NOT NULL, `endY` REAL NOT NULL, `type` INTEGER NOT NULL, `front` INTEGER NOT NULL, `placementAngle` REAL, `isAutoDetected` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`uuid`), FOREIGN KEY(`floorId`) REFERENCES `floor`(`uuid`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE , FOREIGN KEY(`scanId`) REFERENCES `scans`(`uuid`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )+

CREATE TABLE `floor` (`uuid` TEXT NOT NULL, `jobId` TEXT NOT NULL, `order` INTEGER NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `isSelected` INTEGER NOT NULL, `minimapFile` TEXT, `worldBounds` TEXT, `imageBounds` TEXT, `duplicateOfUUID` TEXT, `lastModified` INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(`uuid`), FOREIGN KEY(`jobId`) REFERENCES `job`(`uuid`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE ))

CREATE TABLE `scans` (`uuid` TEXT NOT NULL, `floorId` TEXT NOT NULL, `cameraId` TEXT, `imagePath` TEXT, `cameraModel` TEXT, `cameraManufacturer` TEXT, `cameraSerial` TEXT, `cameraFirmware` TEXT, `duplicateOfUUID` TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(`uuid`), FOREIGN KEY(`floorId`) REFERENCES `floor`(`uuid`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE ))

CREATE TABLE `gallery` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `jobId` TEXT NOT NULL, `floorId` TEXT NOT NULL, `swlUuid` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdDate` INTEGER, `path` TEXT, `placementPath` TEXT, `thumbnailPath` TEXT, `cameraModel` TEXT, `cameraManufacturer` TEXT, `cameraSerial` TEXT, `cameraFirmware` TEXT, `placed` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE `job` (`uuid` TEXT NOT NULL, `showCaseName` TEXT NOT NULL, `addrLine1` TEXT, `addrLine2` TEXT, `addrCity` TEXT, `addrState` TEXT, `addrPostalCode` TEXT, `addrCountry` TEXT, `description` TEXT, `internalId` TEXT, `localUrlImage` TEXT, `lastCreated` INTEGER, `lastModified` INTEGER, `lastUploaded` INTEGER, `path` TEXT, `phoneModel` TEXT, `phoneVersion` TEXT, `cameraSerial` TEXT, `cameraVersion` TEXT, `cameraName` TEXT, `latitude` INTEGER NOT NULL, `longitude` INTEGER NOT NULL, `sid` TEXT, `swlUuids` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', `uploadedSwlUuids` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', `manifestUploaded` INTEGER, `uploadError` TEXT, `uploadProgress` INTEGER NOT NULL, `zoomState` REAL NOT NULL, `duplicating` INTEGER NOT NULL, `failedCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `duplicateOfUUID` TEXT, `lastGalleryId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `address` TEXT, `uploadCounter` INTEGER NOT NULL, `blurFaces` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `corruptedSwls` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY(`uuid`))%
